title: Deep Cradle
shortDescription: A round silk chamber under the nave, built for something larger.
longDescription:
The silk closes into a round room. Larger cocoons hang unopened. One has split along a seam. A dark, patient shape fills the gap.
The air is warm. Three pulses travel the floor. This is not a throne. Alder said she will not wake for one Collegian.

fixtures.name: Still Score
fixtures.lookDescription: A thread-chart pinned to the silk, with a wooden coat-button in the fourth space. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: A thread-chart is pinned to the silk. Three notes are marked in the same count as the oak. The fourth space is not blank in any way that helps. A wooden coat-button — two holes, grey thread still in one — is pressed into the silk there. It is warm. Alder cannot see this from the High Study. Someone kept time on a living keeper.
